## Change

Describe the visitor-facing or operational change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:repo`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check:public`
- [ ] Relevant desktop/mobile interactions reviewed when the UI changed

## Release notes

List any deployment configuration or data migration needed. Keep credentials and visitor data out of this pull request. Merging is a manual owner decision; do not enable auto-merge.
